Q1.operator_words: Outside the project, as project goal
Q1.resolution: Project Declaration outside Project, like Project Goal, with the same external Operator ownership. No filesystem path selected; project-root carrier proposal not adopted.

Q2.resolution: No mandatory minimum number of local Scope Contract Atoms. Zero allowed; no new sufficiency test.

Q3.resolution: Navigation Number, when present, is explicitly declared. Filenames and views that use it derive their displayed number from that declared value; do not maintain a separate authoritative value for the same position.

Q4.operator_words: One atom with role scope unit declaration and active subject = the Scope Unit
Q4.resolution: A Scope Unit Declaration Atom has Role = Requirement and Form = Scope Unit Declaration. Its active Subject (`subjects.active`) identifies the specific Scope Unit instance being declared, not merely the generic Scope Unit kind. Count exactly one matching Declaration Atom per declared Scope Unit. Use this Subject binding; do not require a duplicate binding in Claim or Target Scope Unit. “Active” here names the Subject field, not an added Atom.Status predicate.

Q5.resolution: A Scope Unit Declaration Atom has Role = Requirement and Form = Scope Unit Declaration. Its active Subject (`subjects.active`) identifies the specific Scope Unit instance being declared, not merely the generic Scope Unit kind. Count exactly one matching Declaration Atom per declared Scope Unit. Use this Subject binding; do not require a duplicate binding in Claim or Target Scope Unit. “Active” here names the Subject field, not an added Atom.Status predicate.
Q5.formal_expression: (Atom//.Role = Requirement & .Form = Scope Unit Declaration & .subjects.active = Scope Unit//){:1}

operator_words: we can drop navigational number for scope units
keep only for steps and P
Q6.resolution: Scope Units do not have Navigation Number. Keep their existing Local Order semantics; do not maintain a duplicate navigation position. Navigation Number is retained only for Steps and P (Plan) Atoms. This decision does not add new numbering or Carrier-format rules for those Atoms.
